title: PlayStation Offering $40 Off PS5 Refurb Bundles Ahead of GTA 6
description: PlayStation is offering a $40 discount on bundled purchases of refurbished PS5 consoles and DualSense controllers ahead of GTA 6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Hardware Preparation Ahead of GTA 6

As the gaming community eagerly anticipates the arrival of Grand Theft Auto VI, hardware considerations are becoming a top priority for many players looking to upgrade their setups. According to a recent report by IGN, PlayStation is currently offering a notable discount on hardware bundles, giving consumers a more cost-effective way to acquire a current-generation console.

## The PS5 Refurbished Bundle Discount

Per the report, PlayStation is offering $40 off when players purchase a refurbished PlayStation 5 console and a DualSense wireless controller together. When calculated alongside other potential reductions, this promotional offering can deliver up to $155 in total savings for buyers.

While hardware manufacturers frequently run promotional discounts for various reasons, acquiring official refurbished hardware combined with extra controllers provides an accessible entry point for gamers who have yet to make the jump to the current generation, especially with massive upcoming software releases on the horizon.

## Market Context and Hardware Readiness

Major blockbuster releases historically drive significant console adoption, and the anticipation surrounding GTA 6 is no exception. For players currently evaluating their hardware options, exploring official refurbished bundles represents a practical strategy to balance performance requirements with financial budgets. Keeping an eye on official hardware deals as the release window approaches will likely benefit anyone looking to optimize their gaming setup without paying full retail price for brand-new systems.

## Editor's Take

As the hype for GTA 6 continues to build, hardware costs remain a key factor for players planning their next upgrade. PlayStation's $40 discount on refurbished PS5 and controller bundles offers a smart, budget-friendly option for gamers wanting to secure a capable machine without breaking the bank ahead of the game's launch.
